children: Chief Business Officer, Dylan Wenke, Participates in Virtual Investor "What This Means" Segment
HOUSTON, TX / ACCESS Newswire / September 1, 2026 / CNS Pharmaceuticals, Inc.

("CNS" or the "Company"), a biotechnology company focused on building a pipeline of innovative therapies addressing significant unmet medical needs, today announced that it participated in a Virtual Investor "What This Means" Segment.

Dylan Wenke, Chief Business Officer of CNS Pharmaceuticals, provided an update on its business development strategy as part of its broader transformation as the Company works to establish a pipeline focused on oncology or neurology with best in class potential. Mr. Wenke outlined the Company's rigorous approach to evaluating potential opportunities, highlighting the scientific, clinical, regulatory, and commercial characteristics that define its in-licensing and acquisition targets. The conversation also gives investors insight into the Company's business development process, from sourcing and initial diligence through comprehensive evaluation, along with the rationale behind its focus on oncology and neurology. Looking ahead, Mr. Wenke shared the Company's near-term priorities, emphasizing continued execution of its business development strategy and the pursuit of opportunities that have the potential to create long-term shareholder value.
The Virtual Investor "What This Means" segment is available for on-demand viewing here.

CNS Pharmaceuticals is a biotechnology company focused on developing innovative therapies for serious diseases. With an experienced executive team and a focus on high-value therapeutic opportunities, the Company is working to build a differentiated portfolio of assets addressing significant unmet medical needs. CNS is committed to advancing novel treatments that have the potential to improve patient outcomes while creating long-term value for patients and shareholders.
For more information, please visit www.CNSPharma.com, and connect with the Company on X and LinkedIn.
